method: Visible mouth events read from frames (4fps scans of every take, work/mouthscan/sheets/, plus 12fps fine strips and full-res spot checks for hook-critical frames). Take-audio word times (Gemini app decodes, work/gemini_takes/) are HINTS ONLY: the standing mouth-lag doctrine (take mouth lags its own audio ~0.5-1s class) and dual-system refrain blindness (Whisper hears 'easy' 0 times in the song; the app decodes only 8/30 words of s08_t2) make audio times unfit as anchors. Anchor = first clearly-open mouth frame of the line's performance in the take; fits are phrase-level (one setpts factor per phrase). Sample grid: every 6 frames (0.25s) unless noted. States: O=open, T=transitional, C=closed.
